vignette: John has been a delivery driver for over four decades, navigating the streets of his city with an almost intuitive sense of direction. At seventy-seven years old, he's still out on the road most days, though lately his morning coffee feels less like fuel and more like a propellant pushing him through moments of disquieting anxiety. John's life took a dramatic turn one fateful evening when he was making his last delivery of the day to a quiet suburban neighborhood. The street lights were dim, casting long shadows as John parked his van in front of the house. As he stepped out with the package in hand, he was suddenly confronted by a group of men who demanded he hand over everything he had. Before he could react, they attacked him, leaving him bruised and shaken. The assault shattered John's sense of security. Now, every time he drives through less frequented streets or parks his van at night, the memories flood back with such vivid intensity that it's as if he can feel their rough hands on him again. He often catches himself gripping the steering wheel tightly, scanning his surroundings for any sign of danger, even in broad daylight. John's wife, Sarah, notices a change in her husband. He used to come home and share stories from his routes, but now his conversations are peppered with hesitations and somber silences. She finds him pacing through their house late at night, unable to settle down. The once reliable and calm John is now plagued by intrusive thoughts about the assault, replaying the event over and over in his mind. His occupation as a delivery driver has become increasingly stressful. Deliveries that were once routine are now fraught with anxiety. He becomes particularly agitated when he's alone on the road for extended periods, feeling vulnerable and exposed. John often finds himself double-checking every corner of his van before starting his route, ensuring nothing is amiss. The trauma has also affected how John interacts with others. At first, he felt like withdrawing from social gatherings and even skipped a few family dinners, citing fatigue as the reason. When he does go out, he becomes hypervigilant, constantly on edge, which makes it difficult to enjoy himself. Even at home, he startsleasily at sudden noises or movements, a constant reminder of his heightened state of alertness. Sarah has noticed that John's appetite has decreased and he often wakes up in the middle of the night drenched in sweat from nightmares. These nights are particularly hard for both of them; Sarah tries to soothe him with whispered reassurances while he clings to her, seeking solace in her presence. The nightmares replay the assault vividly, leaving John feeling raw and exhausted when he finally falls back asleep. John's physical symptoms have also intensified. He has frequent headaches and his body often aches from muscle tension. His concentration at work is affected; once reliable with his routes, he now finds himself making errors in judgment that are uncharacteristic of him. The trauma has made it difficult for John to focus on anything but the fear of another attack. Despite these challenges, John still tries to maintain his routine. He believes staying busy helps keep the memories at bay, even though they seem to be lurking just beneath the surface. His days are a blend of driving and trying to tamp down the rising tide of anxiety that threatens to engulf him. The assault has left an indelible mark on his psyche, transforming what was once a comforting sense of routine into a source of constant vigilance. John's world feels smaller now, with each day a balancing act between carrying out his duties and fighting off the overwhelming emotions brought about by the trauma. His resilience is evident in how he continues to face these challenges head-on, but there is an underlying fragility that Sarah notices all too well. As John navigates this new reality, the once familiar streets of his city no longer offer a sense of safety or comfort; instead, they are reminders of a harrowing event that has left him struggling to reclaim his peace of mind.
